tools.name: openapi_spec_inspect
tools.description: Inspect an OpenAPI 3.x / Swagger 2.0 JSON specification for paths, HTTP methods, security schemes, missing descriptions, and schema count.

tools.name: openapi_mock_generate
tools.description: Generate deterministic JSON mock response payloads for every component schema in an OpenAPI 3.x spec or JSON Schema object.

tools.name: graphql_schema_inspect
tools.description: Parse a GraphQL SDL schema or introspection JSON to inventory Types, Queries, Mutations, Subscriptions, Enums, and Input types.

tools.name: graphql_query_build_and_validate
tools.description: Build or validate a GraphQL operation query/mutation string, check brace depth balancing, and extract declared variables.

tools.name: curl_to_code_convert
tools.description: Convert a cURL shell command into clean JavaScript fetch() or Python requests code preserving HTTP method, headers, and request body.

tools.name: sql_format_and_lint
tools.description: Format SQL queries with uppercase keywords & clean clause newlines, and lint for SELECT *, DELETE/UPDATE without WHERE, and SQL injection string patterns.

tools.name: sql_ddl_to_mermaid_er
tools.description: Parse SQL CREATE TABLE DDL statements (columns, PK, FK REFERENCES) into a Mermaid erDiagram schema and normalized table inventory.

tools.name: json_to_typescript_and_zod
tools.description: Infer clean TypeScript interfaces/types from any sample JSON payload.

tools.name: json_schema_validate_and_mock
tools.description: Validate a JSON instance against a JSON Schema (required fields, types, enums, min/max) OR generate deterministic mock JSON matching the schema.

tools.name: jsonpath_query_eval
tools.description: Evaluate JSONPath / dot-path expressions (including $, wildcards *, array indices, and recursive descent ..) over any JSON document.

tools.name: json_structural_diff
tools.description: Compute a deep structural JSON diff (added, removed, changed key paths and exact old -> new values) between two JSON objects or arrays.

tools.name: json_to_csv_convert
tools.description: Flatten an array of JSON objects into RFC-4180 CSV with escaped quotes and unified header columns.

tools.name: csv_profile_and_query
tools.description: Parse RFC-4180 CSV data and compute per-column types, null rates, distinct cardinalities, and numeric min/max/avg statistics.

tools.name: ndjson_stream_analyze
tools.description: Validate and profile newline-delimited JSON (.ndjson / .jsonl) logs, detect malformed lines, and summarize schema keys.

tools.name: yaml_json_convert
tools.description: Convert YAML configuration documents to formatted JSON (or JSON back to YAML).

tools.name: xml_format_and_to_json
tools.description: Pretty-print and balance-check XML documents and extract tag hierarchy counts.

tools.name: js_code_complexity_analyze
tools.description: Analyze JavaScript/TypeScript source code for function declarations, import/export dependencies, cyclomatic complexity branches, and LOC metrics.

tools.name: semver_range_evaluate
tools.description: Parse Semantic Versioning (SemVer 2.0) versions and evaluate whether candidate versions satisfy ^, ~, >=, <=, or comparator ranges.

tools.name: junit_tap_test_report_parse
tools.description: Parse JUnit XML or TAP (Test Anything Protocol) test result reports into structured pass/fail/skip counts and failing test trace details.
